Ceate an SVG of an awkward family portrait of robots. Give each robot a distinct personality, and suggest their relationships through poses and composition. No text.

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result, so
  ./output/ holds those finished image/video files and nothing else.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.11.1 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep the code you write to make the files in the working directory (its root, or a subdirectory
  like ./src/, but not in ./output/): it's published as the source. Delete intermediate files such
  as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

content.text: The portrait will be a studio sitting: a stiff parent, a parent leaned away from a missed embrace, a teenager apart from the group, a child trying too hard, a toddler looking elsewhere, and a dog on someone’s foot. I’ll draw that as SVG so the poses carry the relationships.

    <!-- hood -->
    <path d="M96 520 C70 430 150 360 230 410 C250 470 210 540 250 600 L160 590 C120 560 110 540 96 520 Z" fill="#6e342f"/>
    <path d="M104 500 C120 450 190 420 226 460" fill="none" stroke="#8f4a44" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- head turned out, visor catching the camera anyway -->
    <g transform="rotate(-18 168 505)">
      <rect x="108" y="430" width="124" height="146" rx="18" fill="#2a2e35"/>
      <rect x="118" y="448" width="104" height="112" rx="12" fill="#181b20"/>
      <rect x="128" y="492" width="86" height="26" rx="6" fill="#0c0e11"/>
      <!-- pupils shoved to the inner corner: side-eye back at the lens -->
      <circle cx="186" cy="505" r="6" fill="#7ef0d8"/>
      <circle cx="204" cy="505" r="6" fill="#7ef0d8"/>
      <circle cx="183" cy="502" r="2" fill="#f4fffd"/>
      <circle cx="201" cy="502" r="2" fill="#f4fffd"/>
      <!-- catchlights stuck upper-left, not on the pupils -->
      <rect x="134" y="496" width="5" height="5" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"/>
      <path d="M146 542 h40" stroke="#8aa" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.0"/>
      <path d="M142 546 q22 8 46 -6" fill="none" stroke="#6d7682" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <!-- earbud cable they would not pocket -->
    <path d="M214 530 C250 560 180 640 240 720 C280 780 210 830 250 900" fill="none" stroke="#1a1c20" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="526" r="7" fill="#111"/>
    <circle cx="250" cy="902" r="5" fill="#111"/>
    <!-- arms locked -->
    <path d="M150 720 C210 700 270 760 292 800" fill="none" stroke="#2a2e34" stroke-width="30" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M168 800 C220 770 270 730 300 748" fill="none" stroke="#1c2026" stroke-width="28" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="156" cy="730" r="12" fill="#101216"/>
    <circle cx="176" cy="808" r="12" fill="#101216"/>
    <!-- vent, half hidden by the arms -->
    <g stroke="#0e1013" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(168 860)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="26" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="8" x2="26" y2="8"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="16" x2="26" y2="16"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- BRACKET legs and torso. Arms are split so one can land on the teen and one can miss Lumen. -->
  <g id="dad-body">
    <path d="M470 800 V1188" stroke="url(#dadMetal)" stroke-width="52" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M630 800 V1166" stroke="#3c4a58" stroke-width="52" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M456 820 V1160" stroke="#9aabba" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="470" cy="800" r="22" fill="#161b20"/>
    <circle cx="630" cy="800" r="22" fill="#161b20"/>
    <!-- neat boot, square to the lens -->
    <rect x="424" y="1168" width="100" height="52" rx="14" fill="#2a3138"/>
    <rect x="424" y="1168" width="100" height="14" rx="6" fill="#46525e"/>
    <!-- torso -->
    <rect x="400" y="430" width="290" height="390" rx="22" fill="url(#dadMetal)"/>
    <rect x="418" y="452" width="254" height="340" rx="14" fill="none" stroke="#24303a" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.45"/>
    <!-- polished chest plate, the one thing he prepared -->
    <rect x="478" y="500" width="130" height="150" rx="8" fill="#6d7d8d"/>
    <rect x="490" y="514" width="106" height="122" rx="4" fill="#8ea0b2" opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="492" cy="516" r="4" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="594" cy="516" r="4" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="492" cy="624" r="4" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="594" cy="624" r="4" fill="#24303a"/>
    <g stroke="#1d262e" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(520 560)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="40" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="10" x2="40" y2="10"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="20" x2="40" y2="20"/>
    </g>
    <!-- neck and square head -->
    <rect x="512" y="360" width="64" height="84" rx="10" fill="#3a4652"/>
    <rect x="458" y="196" width="184" height="176" rx="16" fill="url(#dadHead)"/>
    <path d="M470 214 h24" stroke="#c5d0da" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55"/>
    <!-- ding he did not have time to panel-beat -->
    <path d="M458 230 q18 8 8 26" fill="none" stroke="#2a333c" stroke-width="4"/>
    <rect x="486" y="268" width="132" height="48" rx="8" fill="#14191e"/>
    <!-- attempted wink: slits refuse to match -->
    <rect x="502" y="282" width="42" height="8" rx="3" fill="#d5e1ea"/>
    <rect x="562" y="292" width="42" height="8" rx="3" fill="#d5e1ea"/>
    <rect x="506" y="283" width="7" height="5" fill="#fff"/>
    <rect x="566" y="293" width="7" height="5" fill="#fff"/>
    <!-- where a mouth would be installed -->
    <rect x="524" y="336" width="56" height="6" rx="2" fill="#2c353e"/>
    <circle cx="500" cy="250" r="5" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="600" cy="250" r="5" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="430" cy="500" r="20" fill="#161b20"/>
    <circle cx="664" cy="496" r="20" fill="#161b20"/>
  </g>

  <!-- hand that pins Slate and is being escaped -->
  <g id="dad-pin">
    <path d="M430 510 C360 560 330 600 300 640" fill="none" stroke="#3e4c5a" stroke-width="40" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M430 496 C366 544 338 582 308 622" fill="none" stroke="#8b9bab" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45"/>
    <circle cx="392" cy="548" r="14" fill="#161b20"/>
    <g transform="translate(250 612) rotate(-28)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="58" height="40" rx="12" fill="#3e4c5a"/>
      <rect x="46" y="-16" width="14" height="28" rx="6" fill="#4a5866"/>
      <rect x="46" y="8" width="16" height="26" rx="6" fill="#445264"/>
      <rect x="44" y="30" width="14" height="24" rx="6" fill="#3a4856"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- LUMEN, feet planted, torso tipped away from the claw -->
  <g id="mom">
    <path d="M850 1040 V1228" stroke="#c98468" stroke-width="40" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M930 1040 V1224" stroke="#b56e52" stroke-width="40" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="850" cy="1248" rx="40" ry="16" fill="#8d5340"/>
    <ellipse cx="934" cy="1244" rx="40" ry="16" fill="#7d4a3a"/>
    <circle cx="850" cy="1036" r="16" fill="#161b20"/>
    <circle cx="930" cy="1036" r="16" fill="#161b20"/>
    <g transform="rotate(8 900 1040)">
      <ellipse cx="900" cy="820" rx="128" ry="175" fill="url(#momMetal)"/>
      <ellipse cx="910" cy="860" rx="78" ry="110" fill="#f6e3d4"/>
      <ellipse cx="880" cy="760" rx="40" ry="22" fill="#f8d2c2" opacity="0.4"/>
      <g stroke="#a8644c" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(868 900)">
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="28" y2="0"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="9" x2="28" y2="9"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="18" x2="28" y2="18"/>
      </g>
      <!-- brooch, her only dressing-up, sitting a little left of center -->
      <circle cx="860" cy="800" r="14" fill="#f4efe6" stroke="#c9b8a4" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="855" cy="795" r="4" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"/>
      <!-- spoon still clipped on from before they left -->
      <g transform="translate(1004 900) rotate(18)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="70" rx="4" fill="#d9d3c8"/>
        <ellipse cx="6" cy="-6" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#e6e0d6"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="790" cy="690" r="18" fill="#161b20"/>
      <circle cx="1004" cy="710" r="18" fill="#161b20"/>
      <!-- cradle arms, both busy, so the embrace cannot be returned -->
      <path d="M790 700 C740 780 760 900 830 960" fill="none" stroke="#e0a184" stroke-width="36" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M1000 720 C1040 820 980 940 900 990" fill="none" stroke="#c47b5e" stroke-width="34" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect x="868" y="640" width="70" height="78" rx="16" fill="#d28b70"/>
      <g transform="rotate(6 900 500)">
        <circle cx="900" cy="500" r="74" fill="url(#momMetal)"/>
        <circle cx="876" cy="430" r="10" fill="#161b20"/>
        <!-- broken stub of the other antenna -->
        <rect x="940" y="436" width="8" height="16" rx="3" fill="#a86852"/>
        <ellipse cx="900" cy="508" rx="48" ry="40" fill="#f8e6d8"/>
        <ellipse cx="878" cy="500" rx="14" ry="18" fill="#f4fffb"/>
        <ellipse cx="924" cy="496" rx="14" ry="18" fill="#f4fffb"/>
        <circle cx="874" cy="504" r="7" fill="#2f5c54"/>
        <circle cx="918" cy="500" r="7" fill="#2f5c54"/>
        <!-- catchlights locked to the flash, pupils a little high -->
        <circle cx="870" cy="496" r="2.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="914" cy="492" r="2.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <path d="M864 478 q12 -10 24 0" fill="none" stroke="#8d4d3c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M910 474 q12 -10 26 0" fill="none" stroke="#8d4d3c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <!-- smile, center lamp dim -->
        <circle cx="868" cy="542" r="3.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="884" cy="546" r="3.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="548" r="3.4" fill="#e4b9a6"/>
        <circle cx="916" cy="546" r="3.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="932" cy="542" r="3.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <ellipse cx="858" cy="528" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#f0b2a6" opacity="0.7"/>
        <ellipse cx="944" cy="526" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#f0b2a6" opacity="0.7"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- claw that stopped beside her antenna instead of on her shoulder -->
  <g id="dad-claw">
    <path d="M660 500 L790 418" fill="none" stroke="#445363" stroke-width="42" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M788 420 L868 508" fill="none" stroke="#3a4856" stroke-width="38" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M668 486 L792 408" fill="none" stroke="#93a4b4" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>
    <circle cx="786" cy="422" r="16" fill="#161b20"/>
    <!-- palm and two prongs that frame the antenna without touching it -->
    <circle cx="874" cy="524" r="26" fill="#3e4c5a"/>
    <rect x="852" y="470" width="16" height="48" rx="7" fill="#526070" transform="rotate(-18 860 494)"/>
    <rect x="892" y="468" width="16" height="50" rx="7" fill="#526070" transform="rotate(16 900 493)"/>
    <!-- shadow of the claw on the backdrop, a second copy of the miss -->
    <ellipse cx="900" cy="575" rx="36" ry="10" fill="#6d7c6a" opacity="0.45" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- the surviving antenna, drawn over the claw so the gap is obvious -->
  <g id="antenna" transform="rotate(8 900 1040)">
    <g transform="rotate(6 900 500)">
      <rect x="868" y="392" width="8" height="42" rx="3" fill="#a86852"/>
      <circle cx="872" cy="384" r="12" fill="#f2d2c4" stroke="#a86852" stroke-width="3"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- NUB, twisted toward the dog, one sock still on -->
  <g id="toddler" transform="rotate(-16 830 760)">
    <ellipse cx="836" cy="790" rx="62" ry="54" fill="url(#nubMetal)"/>
    <ellipse cx="844" cy="804" rx="36" ry="32" fill="#eef8fb"/>
    <circle cx="836" cy="700" r="52" fill="url(#nubMetal)"/>
    <circle cx="836" cy="706" r="34" fill="#f3fbfe"/>
    <!-- sprout -->
    <path d="M836 652 q-6 -28 10 -36" fill="none" stroke="#5ea4c0" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="848" cy="612" r="8" fill="#b7e2c8"/>
    <!-- eyes not agreeing, catchlight left behind -->
    <ellipse cx="820" cy="700" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#fff"/>
    <ellipse cx="854" cy="708" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#fff"/>
    <circle cx="816" cy="706" r="5" fill="#24515e"/>
    <circle cx="858" cy="714" r="5" fill="#24515e"/>
    <circle cx="812" cy="694" r="2.2" fill="#fff"/>
    <circle cx="846" cy="700" r="2.2" fill="#fff"/>
    <ellipse cx="836" cy="732" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#2a4550"/>
    <ellipse cx="806" cy="724" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#f4b7c2" opacity="0.85"/>
    <ellipse cx="868" cy="728" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#f4b7c2" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- reaching arm, stops short of the dog -->
    <path d="M788 790 C720 830 700 900 690 970" fill="none" stroke="#7ebcd4" stroke-width="22" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="792" cy="792" r="10" fill="#161b20"/>
    <g transform="translate(668 952)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="16" height="28" rx="6" fill="#9fd4e8" transform="rotate(-40 8 10)"/>
      <rect x="12" y="6" width="16" height="26" rx="6" fill="#c5e6f2" transform="rotate(-10 16 16)"/>
      <rect x="22" y="2" width="16" height="26" rx="6" fill="#9fd4e8" transform="rotate(20 28 12)"/>
    </g>
    <!-- the other fist bunched in her collar -->
    <circle cx="888" cy="760" r="16" fill="#b7e0ee"/>
    <!-- kicking foot, doubled by the shutter -->
    <ellipse cx="900" cy="860" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#8ecfe6" opacity="0.35" transform="rotate(-20 900 860)"/>
    <ellipse cx="868" cy="868" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#5ea4c0"/>
    <!-- one sock -->
    <ellipse cx="868" cy="868" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#f4f7f2"/>
    <rect x="856" y="858" width="22" height="8" rx="2" fill="#dfe8ea"/>
    <g stroke="#5ea4c0" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(820 800)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="16" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="6" x2="16" y2="6"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- BYTE on the boot that slid forward off the sweep, tail mid-wag -->
  <g id="dog">
    <!-- slid boot under the dog -->
    <path d="M600 1166 C640 1240 700 1320 790 1368" fill="none" stroke="#3c4a58" stroke-width="50" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="804" cy="1384" rx="78" ry="26" fill="#2a3138" transform="rotate(-16 804 1384)"/>
    <ellipse cx="770" cy="1364" rx="30" ry="10" fill="#566474" transform="rotate(-16 770 1364)"/>
    <!-- lost sock, half under a paw -->
    <path d="M690 1348 q20 -16 34 2 q8 20 -10 24 q-28 6 -24 -26 Z" fill="#f4f7f2"/>
    <path d="M700 1344 q16 8 8 16" fill="none" stroke="#d5e0e4" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="748" cy="1264" rx="92" ry="40" fill="url(#dogMetal)"/>
    <ellipse cx="760" cy="1272" rx="52" ry="24" fill="#f3d2b4"/>
    <!-- haunches -->
    <ellipse cx="820" cy="1290" rx="36" ry="28" fill="#c97840"/>
    <path d="M700 1320 v28" stroke="#a86432" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M748 1324 v26" stroke="#c48452" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M800 1316 v24" stroke="#a86432" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="700" cy="1352" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#8d5430"/>
    <ellipse cx="748" cy="1354" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#8d5430"/>
    <!-- head tilted up at Nub, not at the lens -->
    <g transform="rotate(-18 676 1210)">
      <circle cx="676" cy="1216" r="40" fill="url(#dogMetal)"/>
      <rect x="628" y="1210" width="46" height="28" rx="12" fill="#f0c09a"/>
      <ellipse cx="632" cy="1228" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#2a2420"/>
      <ellipse cx="664" cy="1204" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#2a3338"/>
      <ellipse cx="694" cy="1208" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#2a3338"/>
      <circle cx="662" cy="1208" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
      <circle cx="692" cy="1212" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
      <circle cx="658" cy="1200" r="2" fill="#fff"/>
      <circle cx="688" cy="1202" r="2" fill="#fff"/>
      <!-- tongue out the side -->
      <rect x="616" y="1230" width="16" height="22" rx="6" fill="#e57b86"/>
      <!-- ears, one flipped -->
      <ellipse cx="650" cy="1178" rx="12" ry="22" fill="#c97840" transform="rotate(-20 650 1178)"/>
      <ellipse cx="706" cy="1182" rx="12" ry="20" fill="#8d5430" transform="rotate(24 706 1182)"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="700" cy="1246" r="8" fill="#161b20"/>
    <!-- collar and blank tag -->
    <path d="M650 1246 q30 16 62 4" fill="none" stroke="#2c3338" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="684" cy="1264" r="7" fill="#e1c15a"/>
    <!-- wag caught twice -->
    <path d="M860 1260 q40 -30 54 -10" fill="none" stroke="#c97840" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>
    <path d="M860 1272 q36 20 60 8" fill="none" stroke="#a86432" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <g stroke="#8d5430" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(760 1252)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="16" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="6" x2="16" y2="6"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- PIP, too close to the lens, standing in the gap, cape askew -->
  <g id="kid">
    <path d="M430 1040 C520 1100 500 1260 420 1340 C340 1260 300 1160 340 1060 Z" fill="url(#cape)"/>
    <path d="M400 1080 C460 1160 450 1280 390 1320" fill="none" stroke="#f2c14a" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.0"/>
    <!-- clip, one side only -->
    <circle cx="392" cy="1036" r="8" fill="#f4efe6"/>
    <path d="M300 1188 V1408" stroke="#e2b03a" stroke-width="40" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M392 1180 V1396" stroke="#c99428" stroke-width="40" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="1188" r="14" fill="#161b20"/>
    <circle cx="392" cy="1180" r="14" fill="#161b20"/>
    <!-- tiptoe: heels up, shadow only in the toes -->
    <ellipse cx="292" cy="1436" rx="36" ry="14" fill="#2a241c"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="1404" rx="18" ry="8" fill="#c99428"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="1424" rx="36" ry="14" fill="#2a241c"/>
    <ellipse cx="392" cy="1394" rx="18" ry="8" fill="#e2b03a"/>
    <!-- rear toe still on the sweep, front toes on the wood: they stepped out of the pose -->
    <rect x="268" y="1004" width="160" height="200" rx="36" fill="url(#kidMetal)"/>
    <rect x="290" y="1040" width="120" height="130" rx="28" fill="#ffe7a6" opacity="0.35"/>
    <g stroke="#a87218" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(318 1100)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="22" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="8" x2="22" y2="8"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="16" x2="22" y2="16"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="318" y="924" width="52" height="70" rx="14" fill="#e2b03a"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="860" r="86" fill="url(#kidMetal)"/>
    <circle cx="330" cy="800" r="16" fill="#fff" opacity="0.25"/>
    <!-- eager antennae, one bent -->
    <path d="M310 786 v-36" stroke="#c99428" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="310" cy="742" r="10" fill="#fff6dc"/>
    <path d="M390 790 q20 -40 8 -52" fill="none" stroke="#c99428" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="396" cy="732" r="10" fill="#fff6dc"/>
    <!-- face screen blown out by the flash -->
    <rect x="286" y="820" width="130" height="112" rx="40" fill="#fffaf0"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="862" r="16" fill="#2b241c"/>
    <circle cx="392" cy="858" r="19" fill="#2b241c"/>
    <circle cx="320" cy="856" r="5" fill="#fff"/>
    <circle cx="384" cy="850" r="5" fill="#fff"/>
    <!-- smile too wide, one tooth lamp dark -->
    <path d="M312 900 Q348 968 392 896 Q348 930 312 900 Z" fill="#2b241c"/>
    <rect x="322" y="908" width="10" height="12" rx="1" fill="#fffaf0"/>
    <rect x="336" y="914" width="10" height="12" rx="1" fill="#fffaf0"/>
    <rect x="350" y="914" width="10" height="12" rx="1" fill="#c9b8a4"/>
    <rect x="364" y="908" width="10" height="12" rx="1" fill="#fffaf0"/>
    <!-- thumbs-up -->
    <path d="M430 1040 C470 980 490 920 470 860" fill="none" stroke="#f0c04a" stroke-width="28" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="430" cy="1036" r="12" fill="#161b20"/>
    <g transform="translate(448 800)">
      <rect x="0" y="16" width="40" height="32" rx="12" fill="#ffe08a"/>
      <rect x="6" y="-8" width="14" height="30" rx="6" fill="#fff1c2"/>
      <rect x="22" y="20" width="8" height="16" rx="3" fill="#e2b03a"/>
    </g>
    <!-- other hand tugging the locked arm -->
    <path d="M280 1060 C230 980 210 900 236 820" fill="none" stroke="#d9a838" stroke-width="26" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="286" cy="1052" r="12" fill="#161b20"/>
    <g transform="translate(214 792) rotate(-20)">
      <rect width="36" height="26" rx="10" fill="#ffe08a"/>
      <rect x="24" y="-8" width="10" height="18" rx="4" fill="#fff1c2"/>
      <rect x="28" y="8" width="10" height="16" rx="4" fill="#e2b03a"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- flash bloom over the people who stood where they were told -->
  <ellipse cx="760" cy="520" rx="340" ry="260" fill="#fff" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect width="1200" height="1500" fill="url(#vig)"/>
  <rect width="1200" height="1500" filter="url(#grain)" opacity="0.35"/>
</svg>

{"type":"SearchReplace","EditsApplied":{"old_string":"","new_string":"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 1500" width="1200" height="1500">
  <!--
    Awkward studio portrait. Shared dark joint hubs mark one household.
    Bracket: rectangular patriarch, failed wink, arm misses his partner and pins the teen.
    Lumen: rounded, dressed up a little, leaning away to keep her last antenna and the baby clear of that claw.
    Slate: tall model folded into a slouch, off the backdrop, side-eye, arms locked.
    Pip: short, caped, on tiptoe in the gap, smile too big, one tooth-light out.
    Nub: nursery model twisted toward the dog, one sock lost.
    Byte: pet model sitting on the slid boot, tail still moving when the shutter fired.
  -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="wood" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#a08976"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#5e4c40"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="paper" cx="58%" cy="30%" r="78%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f3f6ef"/>
      <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#d5e0d0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a9b7a4"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dadMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8b9aaa"/>
      <stop offset="38%" stop-color="#4d5c6b"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2c3641"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dadHead" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.2" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9aa8b6"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#546274"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#313b46"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="momMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f6c7b0"/>
      <stop offset="42%" stop-color="#e09474"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b56a4e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="teenMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3c414a"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#23262c"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#121417"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="kidMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe08a"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#f0c04a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c48a22"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="nubMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e7f6fb"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#8ecfe6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5ea4c0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dogMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f0c09a"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#e09255"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b56532"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cape" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e15a52"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8d2c2c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="vig" cx="52%" cy="40%" r="72%">
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#1b1612" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1b1612" stop-opacity="0.42"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="soft" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softer" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="14"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="grain">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.85" numOctaves="2" seed="4"/>
      <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0"/>
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.055"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect width="1200" height="1500" fill="#6d5c4e"/>
  <rect y="1100" width="1200" height="400" fill="url(#wood)"/>
  <g stroke="#4e4036" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.55">
    <line x1="0" y1="1192" x2="1200" y2="1210"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="1268" x2="1200" y2="1280"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="1348" x2="1200" y2="1356"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="1436" x2="1200" y2="1430"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#3d322b" opacity="0.35">
    <circle cx="180" cy="1238" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="640" cy="1312" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="990" cy="1390" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="420" cy="1470" r="2"/>
  </g>

  <path d="M0 0 H1200 V1160 Q600 1410 0 1160 Z" fill="url(#paper)"/>
  <path d="M0 1160 Q600 1410 1200 1160" fill="none" stroke="#6d624f" stroke-width="10" opacity="0.28"/>
  <path d="M0 1152 Q600 1396 1200 1152" fill="none" stroke="#f7faf4" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.65"/>

  <!-- backdrop wrinkle and tape, viewer left, where the teen was told to stand -->
  <path d="M30 40 Q90 360 36 760 Q100 1040 24 1180" fill="none" stroke="#93a38e" stroke-width="34" opacity="0.45" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M78 70 Q140 400 70 820" fill="none" stroke="#f4f8f1" stroke-width="5" opacity="0.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="0" y="150" width="42" height="20" rx="2" fill="#d9d0b4" transform="rotate(-12 20 160)" opacity="0.9"/>
  <rect x="6" y="470" width="34" height="16" rx="2" fill="#cfc6aa" transform="rotate(8 20 478)" opacity="0.75"/>

  <!-- cropped light stand -->
  <g stroke="#1c1c1c" fill="#2a2a2a">
    <rect x="1162" y="40" width="16" height="780" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="1088" y="168" width="112" height="12" rx="4"/>
    <circle cx="1090" cy="174" r="16"/>
    <path d="M1104 190 C1080 260 1120 340 1096 430" fill="none" stroke="#1c1c1c" stroke-width="4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- empty booster the toddler would not sit in -->
  <g id="stool">
    <rect x="1004" y="1096" width="10" height="150" rx="3" fill="#8a6a48"/>
    <rect x="1116" y="1096" width="10" height="150" rx="3" fill="#8a6a48"/>
    <rect x="1024" y="1090" width="96" height="16" rx="6" fill="#a6845c"/>
    <ellipse cx="1072" cy="1084" rx="58" ry="16" fill="#6e93a0"/>
    <ellipse cx="1072" cy="1080" rx="36" ry="9" fill="#567887"/>
    <path d="M1030 1046 h84 v28 h-84 z" fill="#7e5a3c"/>
    <rect x="1024" y="1008" width="12" height="70" rx="3" fill="#8a6a48"/>
    <rect x="1108" y="1008" width="12" height="70" rx="3" fill="#8a6a48"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ground shadows -->
  <g fill="#241c17" filter="url(#soft)">
    <ellipse cx="190" cy="1268" rx="100" ry="16" opacity="0.22"/>
    <ellipse cx="530" cy="1264" rx="120" ry="16" opacity="0.28"/>
    <ellipse cx="900" cy="1272" rx="100" ry="15" opacity="0.26"/>
    <ellipse cx="760" cy="1368" rx="90" ry="14" opacity="0.3"/>
    <ellipse cx="360" cy="1455" rx="120" ry="18" opacity="0.34"/>
  </g>

  <!-- SLATE, the teen, off the paper, weight collapsed -->
  <g id="teen">
    <!-- crossed ankles -->
    <path d="M150 1010 C140 1120 120 1180 128 1230" fill="none" stroke="#1a1d22" stroke-width="36" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M230 1000 C250 1120 200 1190 188 1236" fill="none" stroke="#24282f" stroke-width="36" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M118 1000 C130 1100 150 1160 160 1210" fill="none" stroke="#2e333b" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45"/>
    <!-- scuffed outer shoe, bare metal toe; inner shoe intact -->
    <ellipse cx="118" cy="1246" rx="46" ry="18" fill="#14161a"/>
    <ellipse cx="196" cy="1252" rx="48" ry="18" fill="#1c1f25"/>
    <path d="M78 1240 Q96 1224 124 1236 Q100 1248 80 1244 Z" fill="#8d97a3"/>
    <circle cx="150" cy="1005" r="16" fill="#121418"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="998" r="16" fill="#121418"/>
    <!-- long torso, leaned away from the family -->
    <path d="M128 640 C110 760 108 900 124 1005 L250 990 C268 860 286 740 292 655 Z" fill="url(#teenMetal)"/>
    <path d="M150 670 C140 800 146 930 160 1000" fill="none" stroke="#4a515c" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.35" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- mismatched replacement panel -->
    <path d="M196 760 h70 v90 h-70 z" fill="#14171c" transform="rotate(6 230 800)" opacity="0.9"/>
    <path d="M206 778 h48" stroke="#3d4450" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- hood -->
    <path d="M96 520 C70 430 150 360 230 410 C250 470 210 540 250 600 L160 590 C120 560 110 540 96 520 Z" fill="#6e342f"/>
    <path d="M104 500 C120 450 190 420 226 460" fill="none" stroke="#8f4a44" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- head turned out, visor catching the camera anyway -->
    <g transform="rotate(-18 168 505)">
      <rect x="108" y="430" width="124" height="146" rx="18" fill="#2a2e35"/>
      <rect x="118" y="448" width="104" height="112" rx="12" fill="#181b20"/>
      <rect x="128" y="492" width="86" height="26" rx="6" fill="#0c0e11"/>
      <!-- pupils shoved to the inner corner: side-eye back at the lens -->
      <circle cx="186" cy="505" r="6" fill="#7ef0d8"/>
      <circle cx="204" cy="505" r="6" fill="#7ef0d8"/>
      <circle cx="183" cy="502" r="2" fill="#f4fffd"/>
      <circle cx="201" cy="502" r="2" fill="#f4fffd"/>
      <!-- catchlights stuck upper-left, not on the pupils -->
      <rect x="134" y="496" width="5" height="5" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"/>
      <path d="M146 542 h40" stroke="#8aa" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.0"/>
      <path d="M142 546 q22 8 46 -6" fill="none" stroke="#6d7682" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <!-- earbud cable they would not pocket -->
    <path d="M214 530 C250 560 180 640 240 720 C280 780 210 830 250 900" fill="none" stroke="#1a1c20" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="526" r="7" fill="#111"/>
    <circle cx="250" cy="902" r="5" fill="#111"/>
    <!-- arms locked -->
    <path d="M150 720 C210 700 270 760 292 800" fill="none" stroke="#2a2e34" stroke-width="30" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M168 800 C220 770 270 730 300 748" fill="none" stroke="#1c2026" stroke-width="28" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="156" cy="730" r="12" fill="#101216"/>
    <circle cx="176" cy="808" r="12" fill="#101216"/>
    <!-- vent, half hidden by the arms -->
    <g stroke="#0e1013" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(168 860)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="26" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="8" x2="26" y2="8"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="16" x2="26" y2="16"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- BRACKET legs and torso. Arms are split so one can land on the teen and one can miss Lumen. -->
  <g id="dad-body">
    <path d="M470 800 V1188" stroke="url(#dadMetal)" stroke-width="52" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M630 800 V1166" stroke="#3c4a58" stroke-width="52" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M456 820 V1160" stroke="#9aabba" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="470" cy="800" r="22" fill="#161b20"/>
    <circle cx="630" cy="800" r="22" fill="#161b20"/>
    <!-- neat boot, square to the lens -->
    <rect x="424" y="1168" width="100" height="52" rx="14" fill="#2a3138"/>
    <rect x="424" y="1168" width="100" height="14" rx="6" fill="#46525e"/>
    <!-- torso -->
    <rect x="400" y="430" width="290" height="390" rx="22" fill="url(#dadMetal)"/>
    <rect x="418" y="452" width="254" height="340" rx="14" fill="none" stroke="#24303a" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.45"/>
    <!-- polished chest plate, the one thing he prepared -->
    <rect x="478" y="500" width="130" height="150" rx="8" fill="#6d7d8d"/>
    <rect x="490" y="514" width="106" height="122" rx="4" fill="#8ea0b2" opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="492" cy="516" r="4" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="594" cy="516" r="4" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="492" cy="624" r="4" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="594" cy="624" r="4" fill="#24303a"/>
    <g stroke="#1d262e" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(520 560)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="40" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="10" x2="40" y2="10"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="20" x2="40" y2="20"/>
    </g>
    <!-- neck and square head -->
    <rect x="512" y="360" width="64" height="84" rx="10" fill="#3a4652"/>
    <rect x="458" y="196" width="184" height="176" rx="16" fill="url(#dadHead)"/>
    <path d="M470 214 h24" stroke="#c5d0da" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55"/>
    <!-- ding he did not have time to panel-beat -->
    <path d="M458 230 q18 8 8 26" fill="none" stroke="#2a333c" stroke-width="4"/>
    <rect x="486" y="268" width="132" height="48" rx="8" fill="#14191e"/>
    <!-- attempted wink: slits refuse to match -->
    <rect x="502" y="282" width="42" height="8" rx="3" fill="#d5e1ea"/>
    <rect x="562" y="292" width="42" height="8" rx="3" fill="#d5e1ea"/>
    <rect x="506" y="283" width="7" height="5" fill="#fff"/>
    <rect x="566" y="293" width="7" height="5" fill="#fff"/>
    <!-- where a mouth would be installed -->
    <rect x="524" y="336" width="56" height="6" rx="2" fill="#2c353e"/>
    <circle cx="500" cy="250" r="5" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="600" cy="250" r="5" fill="#24303a"/>
    <circle cx="430" cy="500" r="20" fill="#161b20"/>
    <circle cx="664" cy="496" r="20" fill="#161b20"/>
  </g>

  <!-- hand that pins Slate and is being escaped -->
  <g id="dad-pin">
    <path d="M430 510 C360 560 330 600 300 640" fill="none" stroke="#3e4c5a" stroke-width="40" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M430 496 C366 544 338 582 308 622" fill="none" stroke="#8b9bab" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45"/>
    <circle cx="392" cy="548" r="14" fill="#161b20"/>
    <g transform="translate(250 612) rotate(-28)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="58" height="40" rx="12" fill="#3e4c5a"/>
      <rect x="46" y="-16" width="14" height="28" rx="6" fill="#4a5866"/>
      <rect x="46" y="8" width="16" height="26" rx="6" fill="#445264"/>
      <rect x="44" y="30" width="14" height="24" rx="6" fill="#3a4856"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- LUMEN, feet planted, torso tipped away from the claw -->
  <g id="mom">
    <path d="M850 1040 V1228" stroke="#c98468" stroke-width="40" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M930 1040 V1224" stroke="#b56e52" stroke-width="40" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="850" cy="1248" rx="40" ry="16" fill="#8d5340"/>
    <ellipse cx="934" cy="1244" rx="40" ry="16" fill="#7d4a3a"/>
    <circle cx="850" cy="1036" r="16" fill="#161b20"/>
    <circle cx="930" cy="1036" r="16" fill="#161b20"/>
    <g transform="rotate(8 900 1040)">
      <ellipse cx="900" cy="820" rx="128" ry="175" fill="url(#momMetal)"/>
      <ellipse cx="910" cy="860" rx="78" ry="110" fill="#f6e3d4"/>
      <ellipse cx="880" cy="760" rx="40" ry="22" fill="#f8d2c2" opacity="0.4"/>
      <g stroke="#a8644c" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(868 900)">
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="28" y2="0"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="9" x2="28" y2="9"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="18" x2="28" y2="18"/>
      </g>
      <!-- brooch, her only dressing-up, sitting a little left of center -->
      <circle cx="860" cy="800" r="14" fill="#f4efe6" stroke="#c9b8a4" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="855" cy="795" r="4" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"/>
      <!-- spoon still clipped on from before they left -->
      <g transform="translate(1004 900) rotate(18)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="70" rx="4" fill="#d9d3c8"/>
        <ellipse cx="6" cy="-6" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#e6e0d6"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="790" cy="690" r="18" fill="#161b20"/>
      <circle cx="1004" cy="710" r="18" fill="#161b20"/>
      <!-- cradle arms, both busy, so the embrace cannot be returned -->
      <path d="M790 700 C740 780 760 900 830 960" fill="none" stroke="#e0a184" stroke-width="36" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M1000 720 C1040 820 980 940 900 990" fill="none" stroke="#c47b5e" stroke-width="34" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect x="868" y="640" width="70" height="78" rx="16" fill="#d28b70"/>
      <g transform="rotate(6 900 500)">
        <circle cx="900" cy="500" r="74" fill="url(#momMetal)"/>
        <circle cx="876" cy="430" r="10" fill="#161b20"/>
        <!-- broken stub of the other antenna -->
        <rect x="940" y="436" width="8" height="16" rx="3" fill="#a86852"/>
        <ellipse cx="900" cy="508" rx="48" ry="40" fill="#f8e6d8"/>
        <ellipse cx="878" cy="500" rx="14" ry="18" fill="#f4fffb"/>
        <ellipse cx="924" cy="496" rx="14" ry="18" fill="#f4fffb"/>
        <circle cx="874" cy="504" r="7" fill="#2f5c54"/>
        <circle cx="918" cy="500" r="7" fill="#2f5c54"/>
        <!-- catchlights locked to the flash, pupils a little high -->
        <circle cx="870" cy="496" r="2.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="914" cy="492" r="2.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <path d="M864 478 q12 -10 24 0" fill="none" stroke="#8d4d3c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M910 474 q12 -10 26 0" fill="none" stroke="#8d4d3c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <!-- smile, center lamp dim -->
        <circle cx="868" cy="542" r="3.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="884" cy="546" r="3.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="548" r="3.4" fill="#e4b9a6"/>
        <circle cx="916" cy="546" r="3.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="932" cy="542" r="3.4" fill="#fff"/>
        <ellipse cx="858" cy="528" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#f0b2a6" opacity="0.7"/>
        <ellipse cx="944" cy="526" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#f0b2a6" opacity="0.7"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- claw that stopped beside her antenna instead of on her shoulder -->
  <g id="dad-claw">
    <path d="M660 500 L790 418" fill="none" stroke="#445363" stroke-width="42" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M788 420 L868 508" fill="none" stroke="#3a4856" stroke-width="38" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M668 486 L792 408" fill="none" stroke="#93a4b4" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>
    <circle cx="786" cy="422" r="16" fill="#161b20"/>
    <!-- palm and two prongs that frame the antenna without touching it -->
    <circle cx="874" cy="524" r="26" fill="#3e4c5a"/>
    <rect x="852" y="470" width="16" height="48" rx="7" fill="#526070" transform="rotate(-18 860 494)"/>
    <rect x="892" y="468" width="16" height="50" rx="7" fill="#526070" transform="rotate(16 900 493)"/>
    <!-- shadow of the claw on the backdrop, a second copy of the miss -->
    <ellipse cx="900" cy="575" rx="36" ry="10" fill="#6d7c6a" opacity="0.45" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- the surviving antenna, drawn over the claw so the gap is obvious -->
  <g id="antenna" transform="rotate(8 900 1040)">
    <g transform="rotate(6 900 500)">
      <rect x="868" y="392" width="8" height="42" rx="3" fill="#a86852"/>
      <circle cx="872" cy="384" r="12" fill="#f2d2c4" stroke="#a86852" stroke-width="3"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- NUB, twisted toward the dog, one sock still on -->
  <g id="toddler" transform="rotate(-16 830 760)">
    <ellipse cx="836" cy="790" rx="62" ry="54" fill="url(#nubMetal)"/>
    <ellipse cx="844" cy="804" rx="36" ry="32" fill="#eef8fb"/>
    <circle cx="836" cy="700" r="52" fill="url(#nubMetal)"/>
    <circle cx="836" cy="706" r="34" fill="#f3fbfe"/>
    <!-- sprout -->
    <path d="M836 652 q-6 -28 10 -36" fill="none" stroke="#5ea4c0" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="848" cy="612" r="8" fill="#b7e2c8"/>
    <!-- eyes not agreeing, catchlight left behind -->
    <ellipse cx="820" cy="700" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#fff"/>
    <ellipse cx="854" cy="708" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#fff"/>
    <circle cx="816" cy="706" r="5" fill="#24515e"/>
    <circle cx="858" cy="714" r="5" fill="#24515e"/>
    <circle cx="812" cy="694" r="2.2" fill="#fff"/>
    <circle cx="846" cy="700" r="2.2" fill="#fff"/>
    <ellipse cx="836" cy="732" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#2a4550"/>
    <ellipse cx="806" cy="724" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#f4b7c2" opacity="0.85"/>
    <ellipse cx="868" cy="728" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#f4b7c2" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- reaching arm, stops short of the dog -->
    <path d="M788 790 C720 830 700 900 690 970" fill="none" stroke="#7ebcd4" stroke-width="22" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="792" cy="792" r="10" fill="#161b20"/>
    <g transform="translate(668 952)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="16" height="28" rx="6" fill="#9fd4e8" transform="rotate(-40 8 10)"/>
      <rect x="12" y="6" width="16" height="26" rx="6" fill="#c5e6f2" transform="rotate(-10 16 16)"/>
      <rect x="22" y="2" width="16" height="26" rx="6" fill="#9fd4e8" transform="rotate(20 28 12)"/>
    </g>
    <!-- the other fist bunched in her collar -->

content.thinking:
The composition broke down due to transform and coordinate errors.

The mom's head is floating detached from her body. The dad's arm is holding her head instead of her body. The toddler is floating. The dog is tiny at the bottom. The stool is disconnected from the mom. The kid's arms are raised. I need to rebuild the layout so it reads as a coherent family portrait.

The mom's legs are detached below her body. The dog is tiny at the bottom center, likely cropped or misaligned with the boot. The teen head floats above the body via a cable, which may read as an intentional floating screen. The kid looks good and enthusiastic in front.

The dad anchors the composition well. The light stand is solid. The backdrop is too pale and the floor is nearly invisible, leaving only a thin strip for the feet. The mom's head was rotated around her hip point, which threw it far away. I will remove the large rotation and place all parts absolutely.

The 8-degree rotation around the hip point shifted the head roughly 75 pixels. The claw was drawn at the original head position while the head rotated away, so it now appears to hold the head that landed at its own spot. The antenna group shares this same faulty rotation.

The head and body were never joined by a neck. The head sits at y=500 while the body sits at y=820, leaving a 70-pixel gap before any rotation is applied. That missing neck caused the head to float detached from the body.

The toddler is actually positioned between dad and mom, but the description renders it as a whole floating figure rather than a child being held. The dog sits at the bottom edge, yet the description claims it is partially cut off, suggesting the viewBox may be cropping the lower portion of the canvas.

The dog appears tiny and low-contrast against the floor, so it blends into the background. The kid’s raised arms and cape behind him read as genuine enthusiasm. The teen’s hood sits behind his head, and dad’s hand on the shoulder actually works.

The frown path may read as a smile. I will fix this.

Heads and bodies will overlap with necks. The mom's head will sit on her body. Her lean will use small shifts instead of a large rotation. The toddler will rest in her arms. The dog will be enlarged and placed on dad's forward foot. The stool will move beside the mom.

The dad's claw will hover beside the mom's shoulder with a visible gap, so it no longer appears to grab her head. The family group will be tightened into a cohesive portrait rather than scattered figures. The kid's left arm will reach toward the teen, matching the description of the dad's hand resting on the teenage robot's shoulder.

I will rewrite the SVG with a tighter layout. Each figure will be a self-contained group positioned by translate only, avoiding large rotations around distant pivots. The floor seam will sit at y=1080 to create a clearer wood foreground in the bottom third.

The family block will span x=80 to x=1120 and y=180 to y=1400. Dad’s torso center is fixed at (560, 640) with feet at 1180 and head top at 220. Mom sits directly beside him at (860, 760), shorter than dad, with her head overlapping her body. The toddler will sit on mom’s left forearm, overlapping her belly and resting its head against her chest.

The teen will sit to the left with a slouched head at y=340 and feet at 1200. His shoulder will touch dad's fingertips, leaving only a thin gap between their bodies.

The kid will stand in front at (400, 1000) with feet at 1420. He will overlap dad's left leg and the teen's right leg, raising one arm while resting the other on the teen's arm.

The dog will be enlarged to roughly 160 pixels wide and placed on dad's right boot at (720, 1280). It will sit between dad and mom, looking up at the toddler, with the toddler's hand reaching down through a clear small gap.

The stool will sit just to the right of mom, partly behind her, with an empty seat at hip height. Each robot will be built in local coordinates where the origin is its hip center, then translated into the scene. Dad’s local origin is fixed at (0, 0) between his feet, and his torso rectangle is drawn relative to that point.

I am abandoning the local-coordinate approach. I will lay out each figure in absolute coordinates on a 1200 by 1500 canvas, carefully checking that the head overlaps the torso and the legs align with the boots.

Dad’s head, neck, and torso are now locked to absolute coordinates. His left leg and boot sit at 490–500 by 720–1080, while his right leg and boot extend forward to 640–700 by 1100–1120. The left arm reaches the teen’s shoulder at 300 by 620, and the right arm is placed so it cannot overlap mom’s head. Mom’s feet rest at 900 and 980 with her hips at y=760; her torso ellipse centers at 930 by 700.

The mom’s head and torso now overlap by twenty pixels. Her claw will hover at x=800, y=560, just above and outside her shoulder, leaving a twenty-pixel gap so it never touches her face.

The toddler is now placed at (900, 740) with its head overlapping mom's chest. Mom's arm will wrap around the baby so the near arm overlaps it. The dog is enlarged to a large ellipse and sits on dad's boot at (760, 1180), looking up toward the toddler. The gap between them is about eighty pixels. The teen layout is next.

The teen is now drawn with a lean path instead of a distant pivot. His torso sits at x=140 by y=520 and his head at x=120 by y=390, overlapping the torso top to form a connected body. The hood sits behind his head, and his crossed arms rest at y=640–760. Dad’s hand will overlap the teen’s right shoulder at x=280 by y=600.

The kid is placed in front at x=250–450 with feet at y=1360. He overlaps the teen’s legs and dad’s left leg, raising one arm toward the teen while giving a thumbs-up with the other.

The stool is drawn first at x=1040–1140 with its seat at y=980, slightly overlapping mom’s right edge.

The floor will curve gently from y=1000 to y=1120 so the wood seam sits just below the adult feet. The kid and dog will stand on that visible wood in front.

The teen’s head will sit clearly on his body, and his frown will be drawn more explicitly.

Mom’s arms are now mapped out: her left arm reaches under the baby, while her right arm crosses over the baby’s back.

The draw order is now fixed: stool, shadows, teen body, dad body, dad left arm and hand, mom torso and head, toddler, mom front arm, dad right arm with claw, antenna, dog, and kid. The dad’s claw will sit beside the mom’s shoulder so it can hover over the gap between them without touching her face. The kid’s arms will be corrected so one reaches sideways toward the teen’s forearm while the other gives a clear thumbs-up.

The kid’s arm will wrap around dad’s left thigh instead of reaching up toward the teen, making his affection explicit while dad’s leg stays behind him. The other hand will give a thumbs-up beside his head. A dangling cable held by the kid is also being considered as a clearer prop.

The kid will hold the teen’s cable in one hand and give a thumbs-up with the other. The family block is being tightened to three equal 80-pixel gaps, so the portrait feels cohesive rather than scattered.

The previous floor curve extended too far downward, hiding the wood. I will raise it so the foreground wood is clearly visible.

The paper edge will rise to y=1000 and the center seam to y=1180 so the wood floor remains visible in the foreground. Adult feet will sit at y=1140 on the wood edge, while the kid’s feet stay fully on the wood at y=1360. Face details will be enlarged and sharpened so expressions read clearly: dad’s wink will use a shorter offset eye slit, and the teen’s frown will get a downward curve with cyan eyes.

A light vignette will remain, but the grain texture will be kept subtle or removed if it muddies the image. Story props such as the brooch, broken antenna, baby sock, dog on a sock, empty stool, and tape will stay attached to their respective bodies. Dad’s head is set to 170 pixels, mom’s to 140, and the teen’s to 120, so the portrait scale feels balanced rather than dominated by one figure.

The kid’s head is now 150 pixels and the toddler’s 100, while the dog’s head is 90. This foreground scale exaggerates the “too close to the camera” awkwardness. The SVG will stay under 2 MB. The mom’s left arm will trace a U-shape around the baby from her shoulder, keeping the hand visible beside the baby.

The baby’s legs will dangle in front of mom’s belly, one leg kicked out with a ghost and one bare. Its arm points down toward the dog. Dad’s claw will sit with its elbow up, ending thirty pixels left of mom’s antenna so it never touches her head. Dad’s left hand will overlap the teen’s right shoulder by fifteen pixels to show weight resting on the teen.

The teen’s mouth will be drawn as a clear frown with a downward curve. The kid’s tooth will be dark and centered. A shared shadow will sit beneath the entire group on the floor. The dog’s head will rotate slightly upward so its tongue points toward the toddler.

The dog will rotate around its own head center to avoid stray transforms. The stool is now a small child’s chair peeking from behind mom’s right elbow, drawn before her so it overhangs the right edge. The light stand stays at the far right. The teen will stand with feet clearly below the paper seam while the parents’ heels rest on the paper.

The paper seam will be a quadratic curve peaking at y=1240, so the teen’s feet at y=1160 sit clearly on the wood floor while the dad’s center feet may rest on the paper. A visible curl highlight will be added to the paper edge. The kid’s hand will tug the teen’s cable at x=260 by y=780. The SVG will be written with absolute coordinates and clear comments.

The baby’s head will sit at y=680 so it rests just below the mom’s chin. Her near arm will be lighter and her far arm darker to show depth. Rivet joints will be added to the bodies, and the dad’s chest plate stays.

The dad’s arm will slope downward to the shoulder level, stopping beside the upper arm rather than hovering over the mom’s face. A deliberate gap of at least twenty-four pixels will keep the claw from touching her head.

The dad’s elbow is fixed at (800, 430) to form an awkward chicken wing. His hand will sit at (820, 560), just above the mom’s shoulder and thirty-two pixels from her head. The dad’s arm will cross in front of the backdrop between the parents, creating a sharp angular silhouette.

The previous arm placement had crossed over the mom’s head; the new coordinates prevent that overlap. The SVG is being rewritten with a tighter, more complete structure. Each robot will be drawn as an extreme silhouette so its personality and relationships read clearly: the teen closed and leaning away, dad rigid with one arm down on the teen and one short arm up, mom round and curved around the baby while turning from dad, baby twisted reaching down, and kid star-shaped in front.

Mom’s head will tilt eight degrees left toward the baby. The teen’s head will rotate twelve degrees left, with eyes offset right so he looks back. The invisible cape path is being removed. The dog’s sock will be bright and partially visible.

Pip’s cape will drape off one shoulder in bright red to show the family is dressed up. The portrait aspect ratio stays correct for a formal photo. The kid’s left hand will reach up to rest on the teen’s shoulder, while his right hand gives a thumbs-up.

The kid’s hand will stay on the teen’s shoulder, and the thumbs-up will be sharpened. The main bugs are now clear: mom’s legs were drawn outside her rotated body group so they stayed fixed while her torso lifted, which made her look disconnected; the baby was floating because its legs were not attached to its body; the dog was too small; and the dad’s claw was swallowing the mom’s head.

The body ellipse bottom sits at y=995 while the legs start at y=1040, so the torso already looked legless before rotation. The legs will be thickened and overlapped with the hips to look attached, and the body will be lowered so it meets them. The stool will be placed directly beside mom.

The dog will be enlarged and raised to sit inside the family cluster rather than in the bottom margin. A darker outline shade will make it read clearly against the floor colors, and a forty-pixel margin will keep it fully inside the canvas.

The dog will sit on the dad’s extended boot toe at y=1320, with the boot running from his knee down to y=1280. The dog’s head will rest on the paper so it reads clearly against the sage background, while its body can overlap the seam. A darker behind-shape contour was considered but rejected in favor of relying on color contrast alone.

The teen’s torso will be a leaning parallelogram so he looks slouched. The head will overlap the top-left of that torso, and a hood will sit behind it. Dad’s hand will reach up to the top-right of the torso, with fingertips crossing into it. The ground line contact is also being added.

content.text: The first render pulled the mother apart: her head, arms, and the baby didn’t share a body. I’m rebuilding the portrait so each robot is one figure and the poses still show who is avoiding whom.

{"type":"SearchReplace","EditsApplied":{"old_string":"","new_string":"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 1500" width="1200" height="1500">
  <!--
    Studio portrait of one household. The same dark joint hubs and three-slot vent recur on every body.
    Bracket, tall and rectangular, attempted a wink and an embrace; the wink stuck halfway and the claw stopped short.
    Lumen, rounder, tilted away to keep that claw off her last antenna, both arms full of the baby.
    Slate, the tall child, folded into a slouch and stepped off the backdrop paper.
    Pip, closest to the lens, caped and on tiptoe, trying to haul Slate into the group.
    Nub twisted toward the dog instead of the camera and kicked one sock off.
    Byte sat on Bracket's boot, which slid forward, and wagged through the exposure.
  -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="wood" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#b29580"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6a5648"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="paper" cx="55%" cy="28%" r="75%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4f7f1"/>
      <stop offset="42%" stop-color="#d7e2d2"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b3c0ad"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dadMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#93a3b3"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#526172"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2c3742"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="momMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f7cbb4"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#e09272"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b5654c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="teenMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3e4450"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#23272e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#121418"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="kidMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe59a"/>
      <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#f0be45"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c48c22"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="nubMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f2fbfe"/>
      <stop offset="42%" stop-color="#8ecfea"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5aa3c2"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dogMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f6c7a2"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#e08d4e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b86430"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cape" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ef6a60"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8e2e2c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="vig" cx="50%" cy="42%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="58%" stop-color="#1c1714" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1c1714" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="soft" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="grain">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="2" seed="3"/>
      <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0"/>
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.05"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect width="1200" height="1500" fill="#6a5648"/>
  <rect y="980" width="1200" height="520" fill="url(#wood)"/>
  <g stroke="#5a463c" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.55">
    <line x1="0" y1="1124" x2="1200" y2="1136"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="1228" x2="1200" y2="1236"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="1336" x2="1200" y2="1340"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="1448" x2="1200" y2="1442"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#3e312a" opacity="0.4">
    <circle cx="140" cy="1188" r="2.4"/>
    <circle cx="520" cy="1288" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="860" cy="1372" r="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="1464" r="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- seamless paper. Front edge is higher at the sides, so the teen's feet miss it. -->
  <path d="M0 0 H1200 V980 Q600 1185 0 980 Z" fill="url(#paper)"/>
  <path d="M0 980 Q600 1185 1200 980" fill="none" stroke="#6a5d50" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <path d="M0 974 Q600 1174 1200 974" fill="none" stroke="#f6faf3" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.7"/>

  <path d="M18 30 Q70 280 24 620 Q90 900 16 1000" fill="none" stroke="#8ea38a" stroke-width="28" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M58 50 Q110 300 52 700" fill="none" stroke="#f7faf4" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45"/>
  <rect x="-4" y="120" width="40" height="18" rx="2" fill="#ddd4b8" transform="rotate(-8 16 129)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="360" width="32" height="14" rx="2" fill="#d2c8ac" transform="rotate(6 16 367)" opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- stand left in the frame -->
  <g fill="#1e1e1e">
    <rect x="1164" y="24" width="14" height="860"/>

  </g>

  <!-- booster nobody used -->
  <g id="stool">
    <rect x="1036" y="1004" width="9" height="130" rx="3" fill="#8d6b49"/>
    <rect x="1122" y="1004" width="9" height="130" rx="3" fill="#8d6b49"/>

  <g fill="#2a211c" filter="url(#soft)">
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="1165" rx="90" ry="14" opacity="0.28"/>
    <ellipse cx="560" cy="1155" rx="130" ry="16" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- SLATE -->
  <g id="teen">
    <path d="M155 860 C140 980 150 1060 145 1125" fill="none" stroke="#1c2026" stroke-width="34" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M230 860 C255 990 210 1080 200 1132" fill="none" stroke="#2a3038" stroke-width="34" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- scuffed toe -->
    <path d="M104 1136 Q130 1120 156 1136 Q132 1148 106 1142 Z" fill="#9aa6b2"/>
    <circle cx="160" cy="855" r="14" fill="#101216"/>
    <circle cx="228" cy="852" r="14" fill="#101216"/>
    <!-- hood behind the head -->
    <path d="M108 470 C90 390 180 340 250 400 C268 460 230 520 248 590 L150 600 C118 540 112 510 108 470 Z" fill="#6b3330"/>
    <path d="M118 455 C140 400 200 378 242 430" fill="none" stroke="#93514a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.75"/>
    <!-- leaning torso, shoulder toward Bracket pulled down by the hand -->
    <path d="M132 560 C118 680 124 800 150 870 L268 852 C286 720 300 620 286 548 Z" fill="url(#teenMetal)"/>
    <path d="M196 700 h62 v70 h-62 z" fill="#14181d" transform="rotate(4 227 735)"/>
    <path d="M150 590 C140 720 150 820 168 860" fill="none" stroke="#5a6572" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.28"/>
    <!-- neck + head turned away -->
    <rect x="168" y="500" width="36" height="70" rx="10" fill="#2a2f36"/>
    <g transform="rotate(-14 175 455)">
      <rect x="118" y="392" width="118" height="132" rx="16" fill="#2c3138"/>
      <rect x="130" y="408" width="96" height="100" rx="12" fill="#171b20"/>
      <rect x="140" y="446" width="78" height="24" rx="6" fill="#0c0e12"/>
      <circle cx="196" cy="458" r="6.5" fill="#79f0d4"/>
      <circle cx="212" cy="458" r="6.5" fill="#79f0d4"/>
      <circle cx="194" cy="455" r="2.2" fill="#fff"/>
      <circle cx="210" cy="455" r="2.2" fill="#fff"/>
      <rect x="146" y="450" width="6" height="5" rx="1" fill="#fff" opacity="0.85"/>
      <path d="M150 492 q24 16 50 0" fill="none" stroke="#8b97a4" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <path d="M230 470 C270 510 200 600 250 690 C290 760 230 820 268 880" fill="none" stroke="#14171b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="230" cy="466" r="7" fill="#111"/>
    <circle cx="268" cy="882" r="5" fill="#111"/>
    <!-- arms locked. The cable hangs in front of them, where Pip can grab it. -->

    <path d="M168 770 C230 730 275 690 308 710" fill="none" stroke="#1a1e24" stroke-width="26" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- BRACKET body. The pinning arm is after Slate; the missed embrace is after Lumen. -->
  <g id="dad">
    <path d="M500 760 V1108" stroke="url(#dadMetal)" stroke-width="50" stroke-linecap="round"/>

The portrait is `output/awkward-family-portrait.svg`, a studio sitting of one robot household with no lettering.

* The tall gray parent stands square to the lens, one eye stuck in a failed wink. One hand pins the teenager; the other arm stops short of the copper parent's shoulder.
* That parent leans away, both arms full of the baby, one antenna already broken.
* The baby twists toward the dog and reaches down, one sock still on.
* The dog sits on the boot that slid off the backdrop, tongue out, tail caught mid-wag, the lost sock under a paw.
* The teenager has stepped off the paper, hood up, arms locked, eyes slid back toward the camera.
* The yellow child is too close to the lens, cape on, one thumb up, the other hand hauling the teenager in by the cable.
* An empty booster and a cropped light stand sit at the edge of the frame.
